title: Hello, YLang
description: Say hello and return the correct exit type.
hint: The entry point must return an integer status.

title: Variables and types
description: Give the variable the declared integer type.
hint: The initializer and declared type must agree.

title: Mutable values
description: Update the score and print the new value.
hint: A value that is reassigned must be declared mutable using the syntax supported by this compiler.

title: Conditions
description: Compare the temperature with an integer threshold.
hint: Both sides of the comparison should have compatible types.

title: Loops
description: Accumulate the loop counter values.
hint: The accumulator is an integer; add the counter, not a boolean.

title: Functions
description: Pass an integer to the function and return twice its value.
hint: Check the parameter type at the call site.

title: Arrays
description: Read the last valid element in the array.
hint: Array indexes start at zero.

title: Structs
description: Use the fields declared by Point.
hint: The struct declares x and y only.

title: Enums
description: Select a variant that exists in Direction.
hint: Use one of the four declared Direction variants.

title: Strings
description: Print the number of characters in the language name.
hint: Use the standard string length helper with the string value.

title: Modules
description: Import the helper and return its greeting.
hint: The imported function must exist in the neighboring module file.

title: Exhaustive matching
description: Complete the enum match so every direction is handled.
hint: The compiler requires exactly one arm for every declared variant.

title: F-string interpolation
description: Interpolate the declared name into the greeting.
hint: The expression inside braces must refer to a value in scope.

title: Explicit conversions
description: Convert a floating-point value to an integer explicitly.
hint: to_int accepts a float, not a string.

title: Loop control
description: Move the break condition into the loop and stop after three iterations.
hint: break and continue must appear inside a loop body.

title: Text file I/O
description: Write a string to a file and read it back.
hint: io.write_file takes a path and text content.

title: Optional: nested loops
description: Repair the nested loop and calculate the 3 × 3 grid total.
hint: The inner loop should count from 1 through 3 and add its counter to total.

title: Optional: enum logic
description: Fix the enum variant and make the direction check work.
hint: Use an existing enum member and compare values of the same enum type.

title: Optional: struct function
description: Repair the function that computes a rectangle's perimeter.
hint: Perimeter = 2 * (width + height).

title: Optional: JSON parsing
description: Repair the JSON key lookup and read the integer field.
hint: Use json.get_int with the existing score key.

title: Optional: Binary I/O
description: Use the matching endian-aware binary writer and reader.
hint: The write and read helpers must agree on the integer width and byte order.

title: Optional: HTTP streaming
description: Work with a pull-based HTTP stream handle and close it correctly.
hint: The stream API uses http_stream, not a regular string or HTTP task.

title: Optional: Terminal UI
description: Use the terminal UI builtins to initialize, query dimensions, and shut down.
hint: Check each builtin's return type and remember to shut down the terminal.

title: Optional: Voice playback
description: Use the Voice API to initialize playback and handle an audio error.
hint: Voice functions are compiler-recognized builtins; this exercise only checks types and signatures.

title: Optional: JSON builders
description: Create a JSON object and add a numeric property with the immutable builder API.
hint: json.set expects a valid raw JSON value; pass the number as JSON text.

title: Optional: Owned strings
description: Practice explicit owned-string creation, concatenation, and moving.
hint: Use string.own to create an owned value and move when transferring ownership.
